reasoning: Forty independently identified original papers were actually replicated. Appendix 1 supplies target-specific overall subjective verdicts and original study numbers; planned but replaced studies (Cushman et al. 2006, Malle 2006, Lam 2010, Zalla and Leboyer 2011) are excluded. Each appendix entry is copied verbatim because the explicit verdicts occur in list annotations rather than narrative sentences. One target has contradictory verdicts and is left undetermined. No DOI is supplied for any original because none was printed in its inspected reference entry. The supplied url_r points to one component target rather than the overall project; article identity was therefore verified by DOI, title and publisher authors.
